title: Export templates for 4.6.dev6 (Mono) download as 50-byte file instead of full template archive
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in:
4.6.dev6 (Mono, official build from the Godot website)


### System information

Windows 11 64-bit – Godot 4.6.dev6.mono – Vulkan – <your 13900KS / Nvidia 5080>

### Issue description

When attempting to download the 4.6.dev6 (Mono) export templates, the download completes almost instantly and the resulting file is only about 50 bytes in size.

This happens both when:

Downloading export templates from inside the Godot editor (Editor → Manage Export Templates → Download), and

Downloading export templates directly from the Godot website for this version.

The downloaded file is not a valid export template archive (normally these are around 1 GB or more). As a result, it’s not possible to install export templates for 4.6.dev6 (Mono) and exports cannot be configured for this version.

There is no error message; it just silently downloads the tiny file.

### Steps to reproduce

Open Godot 4.6.dev6 (Mono).

Go to Editor → Manage Export Templates….

Click Download and Install (or equivalent button for fetching templates for this version).

Wait for the download to finish.

Observe that the downloaded file is ~50 bytes and does not contain any export templates.

Alternative path:

Go to the Godot Engine website downloads page for 4.6.dev6 (Mono) export templates.

Click the link to download the export templates.

Observe that the downloaded file is also ~50 bytes and not a valid archive.

Expected behavior:
A full export template archive (around 1 GB) should be downloaded and installed so exports can be configured.

Actual behavior:
A ~50-byte file is downloaded instead, which does not contain export templates and cannot be used.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A – The issue occurs before project export and is not project-specific.
